description: Source file defining classes and methods related to audio client descriptors in Android's audio policy framework, including ClientDescriptor, TrackClientDescriptor, RecordClientDescriptor, and SourceClientDescriptor.

classes.name: ClientDescriptor
classes.description: Represents an audio client with port ID, session ID, UID, and configuration details.

classes.name: TrackClientDescriptor
classes.description: Extends ClientDescriptor with additional tracking info such as stream, flags, and activity count.

classes.name: RecordClientDescriptor
classes.description: Extends ClientDescriptor with effect management and source info.

classes.name: SourceClientDescriptor
classes.description: Represents a source client with device and stream attributes, supporting hardware and software output configuration.

classes.name: SourceClientCollection
classes.description: Collection of SourceClientDescriptor objects with dump functionality.

methods.name: toShortString
methods.description: Returns a short string representation of the client descriptor.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs detailed information about the descriptor to a String8 object.

methods.name: trackEffectEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables an effect for the record client.

methods.name: setSwOutput
methods.description: Sets the software output descriptor for a source client.

methods.name: setHwOutput
methods.description: Sets the hardware output descriptor for a source client.
